positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
- Optimized sections of machine learning code for Chief Data Scientist— increased performance by 40%
- Wrote unit tests, isolated and fixed bugs for components of machine learning system
- Assisted in development of machine learning training data
- Reviewed and summarized over 80 recent machine learning arxiv articles and for central repository
- Reimplemented 10+ reinforcement learning algorithms and neural net benchmarks based on arxiv citations for central repository

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description:
- Prepared plans for and taught camp sessions on visual programming languages, Raspberry Pi basics, web development, and Python
- Taught groups with a wide range of skill levels in the same class, ages 6-16
- Wrote daily assessments on individual and group performance

positions.title: STRIDE Research Scholar
positions.description:
- As part of Smith College merit scholarship and stipend undertook year long research project
- Designed and developed several iterations of a website to host photos and information on a collection of Jewish artifacts

positions.title: Code Coach
positions.description:
- Taught after-school lessons on visual programming languages (Scratch, Snap!), web development, and basic Python for small groups and individuals, ages 6-14
- Assessed individual student's development and helping them to pick skill-appropriate and engaging projects
